info.description: UPDATE THIS — the served spec is the single source of truth for MCP tool registration. Add each real endpoint under paths, RELATIVE to servers[0].url.

servers.description: Canonical API base. MUST stay base-path-free: the platform's workspace-tool proxy prepends MOSES_BASE_PATH itself (CHAT-8qiu0). Paths below are relative to this base — the platform's openapi_parser folds servers[0].url + path into the registered endpoint path. Never list /health here (it would register a phantom tool).
